items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Walter Johnson drummer - we were in Fletcher Henderson's band together.

ctx.x: Cuthbert, Georgia. Never heard of it until we were there, but one of my classmates, she always kept in touch. She said, you going with me. They ain't going to take me no place I can't take no chick. She had a brand new Ford. Walter Johnson drummer - we were in Fletcher Henderson's band together. He and I would always hang out together. ... They even killed a calf down there for us. It was nice. We stayed in his home for around about a week. Those people, they're very nice down there.
You say that Fletcher Henderson's father was the mayor of the town?
